title: Zauner–Appleby conjecture on Weyl–Heisenberg SIC fiducials
statement:
Let $U_{\mathcal{Z}}$ be the Zauner unitary associated with the Zauner symplectic matrix

$$
\mathcal{Z}=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}.
$$

A **Weyl–Heisenberg SIC fiducial** is a fiducial vector generating a symmetric informationally complete measurement under Weyl–Heisenberg translations. **Zauner–Appleby conjecture.** In every $d$-dimensional Hilbert space, there exists a Weyl–Heisenberg SIC fiducial that is an eigenvector in the largest eigenspace of $U_{\mathcal{Z}}$. This symmetry prediction is supported by all dimensions in which exhaustive searches have been performed, but remains open in general.
source_name: Hoan Bui Dang, “Studies of symmetries that give special quantum states the "right to exist"”, arXiv:1508.02703 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.02703

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2015).
